attention_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

single_event_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

government_contract_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

fast_5d_benchmark_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with mature 5d event-state row positive versus cash, same-theme replacement, SPY, QQQ, UFO, and ARKX

alpha_hypothesis: Fast-5d all-benchmark-positive Space breakout signals are mis-sized by the accepted stack.

experiment_log_record.hypothesis: Official Space breakout signals with mature all-positive 5d event state may need different default-off allocation than broad 10d benchmark-breadth breakouts.
experiment_log_record.backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md fixed 3-window Space protocol using frozen Space augmented snapshots

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: resize only official Space breakout signals with mature all-positive 5d benchmark confirmation.

2_history_check.exp-20260515-012: Rejected fast-5d benchmark trend risk because it had zero runtime changed signals; this run tests breakout signals.
2_history_check.exp-20260515-004/005: Rejected broad 10d benchmark-breadth breakout variants due old_thin regression; this uses the narrower 5d all-positive event-state field.
2_history_check.exp-20260515-013/015: Rejected satcom candidate-pool expansion; this keeps the official Space candidate set fixed.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_fast_5d_benchmark_breakout_scalar. Candidate pool, accepted Space stack, entries, exits, ranking, stops, add-ons, LLM, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV and PnL versus exp-20260514-053, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 trades, nonzero adjusted signals, and non-1.0 scalar.

experiment_log_record.rejection_reason: Gate 4 failed: no tested fast-5d benchmark breakout scalar improved the fixed windows without regression.
experiment_log_record.next_evidence_needed: New mature Space forward rows or a different production-visible breakout-quality field.

production_impact.notes: Experiment-only monkey patch; no live policy promoted.

experiment_log_record.why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking remains data-limited, broad satcom/ticker expansion failed, and recent benchmark-breadth trend/IWM/peer interactions are accepted, rejected, or sample-limited. This keeps the candidate set fixed and tests one production-visible 5d catalyst-quality field.
